name: stockpulse-engine
description: StockPulse: Multi-Tenant B2B Inventory & Order Engine

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:constraints && npm run test:checkout && npm run test:phase2 && npm run test:phase3 && npm run test:concurrency-demo && npm run test:health && npm run test:docs && npm run test:a11y
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec server npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
